* Severe Thunderstorm Warning for...
Western Hall County in the Panhandle of Texas...
Southeastern Briscoe County in the Panhandle of Texas...

* Until 530 PM CDT.

of Brice, or 12 miles northeast of Caprock Canyon State Park,
moving south at 15 mph.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Expect damage to roofs, siding, and trees.

* Locations impacted include...
Turkey, Caprock Canyon State Park, and Valley Schools.
